exposure: Surgical techniques employed during first-time Cesarean sections
outcome: Observed variations and combinations of surgical steps (e.g., incision type, dissection methods, closure techniques)
cohort: The study participants were 1013 women undergoing first-time Cesarean sections at a tertiary hospital.
finding: The study found a wide variety of surgical methods and combinations of techniques used for first-time Cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The study detailed the diverse surgical techniques employed during Cesarean sections, which is a specific mode of birth.
gest_age: Mean (SD) gestational age at CS was 38.4 +- 3 weeks
